title: Canidae ecology and behavior navigation seed
purpose: Horizontal semantic navigation over reusable ecology and behavior dimensions; this is the default contribution-analysis field.
evidence_boundary: Only populated dimension claims are admitted. Every populated claim names its source and locator. Unresolved or unsupported dimensions are explicit empty arrays; empty cells are not negative assertions.

mammal_diversity_database_v2_5.title: Mammal Diversity Database
mammal_diversity_database_v2_5.use: common names and native biogeographic realms

eltontraits_1_0_mammals.title: EltonTraits 1.0: Species-level foraging attributes of the world's birds and mammals
eltontraits_1_0_mammals.use: diet composition, activity flags, and body mass

animal_diversity_web_species_accounts.title: Animal Diversity Web species accounts
animal_diversity_web_species_accounts.publisher: University of Michigan Museum of Zoology
animal_diversity_web_species_accounts.use: structured habitat, behavior, reproduction, parental investment, thermoregulation, and body-length observations
animal_diversity_web_species_accounts.evidence_note: Account age and completeness vary by species; source absences are not interpreted as biological absences.

elton_dominant_diet_guild_v1.method: Map invertebrates; vertebrates+fish+carrion; fruit+nectar; and seeds+other plant material to invertivore, carnivore, frugivore, and herbivore respectively. A group at or above 50 percent is emitted; otherwise emit omnivore.
elton_dominant_diet_guild_v1.provenance_boundary: Repository-authored deterministic projection over sourced percentages; not a direct source assertion.

elton_max_diet_component_v1.method: Emit every positive diet component tied for the largest percentage.
elton_max_diet_component_v1.provenance_boundary: Repository-authored deterministic projection over sourced percentages; ties remain multi-valued.

elton_activity_flags_v1.input: EltonTraits nocturnal, crepuscular, and diurnal binary flags
elton_activity_flags_v1.method: Encode one active flag directly, two active flags as a compound cycle, and all three as cathemeral.
elton_activity_flags_v1.provenance_boundary: Repository-authored deterministic projection over sourced flags.

adw_controlled_keyword_normalization_v1.method: Lowercase and convert separators to a stable snake-case value without adding biological meaning.
adw_controlled_keyword_normalization_v1.provenance_boundary: Repository-authored lexical normalization over a sourced controlled keyword.

adw_behavior_semantic_projection_v1.input: Animal Diversity Web Key Behaviors keyword
adw_behavior_semantic_projection_v1.method: Project terricolous to ground ecological stratum; cursorial, scansorial, and natatorial to locomotor mode; nomadic and sedentary to migratory strategy; and social or solitary to social organization.
adw_behavior_semantic_projection_v1.provenance_boundary: Repository-authored placement of sourced behavior keywords into governed dimensions.

adw_shelter_narrative_projection_v1.input: Animal Diversity Web Habitat, Reproduction, and Behavior account sections
adw_shelter_narrative_projection_v1.method: Normalize explicitly described den, burrow, vegetation, tree/log, rock/cave, and fallen-tree shelter forms into a compact controlled vocabulary.
adw_shelter_narrative_projection_v1.provenance_boundary: Repository-authored semantic projection over species-account narrative; requires independent review.

conceptual_contract.cross_domain_intent: Dimensions express reusable strategies. Future plant or other-domain adapters may supply domain-specific values without changing navigation mechanics.
